responsibility: This machine-description fragment contains the automaton-based scheduler model for the AArch64 Saphira core. It defines Saphira’s integer, branch, vector/FP, load/store, and register-transfer execution units, then assigns latencies, resource reservations, and selected bypasses for scalar integer, floating-point, AdvSIMD, memory, divide/multiply, and miscellaneous instruction classes keyed by the generated tune attribute, so GCC’s instruction scheduler can model Saphira-specific pipeline usage and timing.
